title: All 3D Windows Show Corner Gizmo
description: All 3D windows must show a gizmo on the lower right corner.
summary:
Every world-3d window now shows a bottom-right orientation gizmo.

React: World3dHost mounts WorldOrbitViewControls (same as CAD InteractionSpatialView) inside WorldOrbitViewSnapGateProvider, so puzzle3d/procedural/fem/gis/lowpoly/shooting/cad play panes all get the interactive XYZ orbit gizmo with camera/projection snap wiring. Hosts are marked with data-orbit-view-gizmo.

wgpu: render_world_3d paints a screen-space XYZ gizmo via paint_world_orbit_view_gizmo using world_orbit_view_gizmo_placement (same inset math as resolveSceneGizmoViewportPlacement).

Also fixed a duplicate silhouette re-export in ui/js/react that blocked vitest, and added UiPresence to the infinite_world scene test helper so the crate tests compile.

Verified: vitest world-3d empty + orbit gizmo host markup; cargo test world_orbit_view_gizmo_placement.
